packet.title: Bounded memory for XML parsing (design and implementation)

body.p: After (tree-sitter parses XML, the owner's choice), (DTD and entities) and (parsing 106 MB took 3.98 GB resident, nearly all tree-sitter's syntax tree of the whole input).

item.p: Specifications: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) [1], [14], [22], [27], [39] to [44], 2.11, 4.3.3; 3 WFC: Element Type Match.
Mechanism: keep tree-sitter and its grammar; parse a document in bounded segments cut at markup boundaries, walk each segment's tree and free it before the next. No header changes.
Owns: src/xml.c, src/xml_segment.c, src/xml_internal.h, grammars/xml/, tests/xml_test.c.

Done when: memory proportional to the depth and the largest item, not the input; error positions, DTD and entities as ; the incremental parse of pauses and resumes; a unit test parses a large generated document under a small allocator limit; resident memory and speed before and after at 10 MB and 100 MB. Done 2026-10-19 (): the head and content segments of 16 KB; 100 MB parses in 98 MB resident (3,789 MB before; the input is 97 MB), CPU 25.0 s to 19.7 s; xmlconf, QT4 and XT40 unchanged case by case.
